handoff_authority.policy: The whole-plan digest is handoff provenance only. Runtime and regression tests bind typed capsule content, identities, and the exact source block rather than a mutable document-wide hash.

candidate.framing: 18 sorted repository-relative UTF-8 paths, each followed by NUL and raw bytes; this evidence record and retained wheel are excluded

architecture.projection: Persisted userMessage and agentMessage items only, in full SDK turn/item order; non-message provider activity and the diagnostic ring are never substituted.
architecture.active_worker: The existing worker control loop reads through its current CodexSdkAdapter and SDK client.
architecture.inactive_and_controller: The supervisor validates exact worker or controller identity and opens one read-only shared-session adapter.
architecture.paging: Newest page first, explicit older-page token, stable redacted snapshot digest, stale-token rejection, 32 fragments and 48 KiB maximum per page.
architecture.limits: 4096 turns, 65536 items, 16 MiB redacted source text, four concurrent reads, five-second response deadline, unchanged 64 KiB authenticated IPC frame.
architecture.state_authority: Conversation pages and pending reads exist only in process memory. SQLite, recovery, lifecycle, result, successor, diagnostic, App, and SDK-dispatch authority are unchanged.
architecture.privacy: Known secrets are replaced before IPC; paths and URLs become typed presence markers; transcript text is absent from ledger, logs, results, recovery, and this evidence.

observable_proof.fixture_history: Production-shaped full SDK turn items reconstruct ordered multi-turn user and agent messages, including an empty userMessage content list, multipart user content and attachment markers across every page. A long message split across pages reassembles as one visible message.
observable_proof.identity: Worker reads bind dispatch, generation, attempt and thread; controller reads bind decision, generation, revision and source thread. Wrong, replaced, stale, malformed, and cross-turn pages fail before display.
observable_proof.loading: The TUI loads the newest page on an explicit lifecycle refresh, loads older pages only on L, always shows current scroll position and bracket keys, and drops all cached pages on disconnect, reconnect identity change, or stale snapshot.
observable_proof.actions: Steer, interrupt, claim, acknowledge, checkpoint re-arm, copy and open remain contextual; exact-turn or exact-decision confirmations remain in place.
observable_proof.privacy: Read-only inactive broker tests leave the SQLite dump byte-for-byte unchanged. Slow reads are capped at four and return an unavailable state at the declared deadline.

real_sdk.interpretation: The official read boundary is reachable, but this authorized native task exposes no persisted turns through the shared SDK. It is not a real multi-turn acceptance proof. No provider call was made.
